CW-008 Consultation Workbench packet family is complete. Please review: docs/pantheon-handoffs/CW-008-consultation-workbench/PACKET_FAMILY.md. Verify: (1) all four modules cover the correct surface scope from the backlog; (2) backend gap matrix rows are accurate against the existing CONSULTATION_SURFACE_CONTRACT.md (CS-01 to CS-06) and the known L3 design intent for ConsultRequest and ConsultMemo; (3) cross-cutting rules correctly prohibit client-side synthesis and correctly cite PKT-005, PKT-001, and F-042 precedents; (4) promotion criteria are consistent with the RW-005 pattern.

Review requested changes. See docs/reviews/WB-008-review-codex.md: CW-01 and CW-04 drift from the cited L3 ConsultRequest/ConsultMemo intent, and the write-authority rules are internally inconsistent.

CW-008 packet family is complete. Four modules defined (CW-01 Consult Request, CW-02 Debate Transcript, CW-03 Committee Board, CW-04 Red-team Memo) — all Wave 4 / not Lovable-ready. Fixed one inconsistency in the backend gap matrix: ConsultMemo row previously claimed 'draft → published → archived' and 'finding severity taxonomy' as L3-promoted truth; corrected to reflect that 'archived' state and per-recommendation severity tiers are net-new contract additions not present in L3, consistent with the CW-04 module spec. Please review PACKET_FAMILY.md for canonical accuracy and approve or request changes.

Review complete: one blocking issue remains. PACKET_FAMILY.md still contradicts itself on Consultation write authority: CW-01 requires POST /api/v1/consult/requests/:request_id/cancel, but the cross-cutting rule says POST /api/v1/consult/requests is the only BFF write route added by this packet family. Please resolve that contradiction and re-handoff for review. See docs/reviews/WB-008-review-codex.md.

Resolved the write-authority contradiction: updated the cross-cutting rule to explicitly list both BFF write routes — POST /api/v1/consult/requests (creation) and POST /api/v1/consult/requests/:request_id/cancel (cancellation, gated by allowedActions.canCancel). The cancel route was already correctly defined in CW-01 backend gaps and module spec; the cross-cutting rule was the sole point of inconsistency. Please review and approve.
Review approved. Consultation write authority is now internally consistent; owner should finalize BP5-WB-008 to done.
